name: Rua
source:
She's a popular girl in the class's elite group. Cheerful and strong-willed.
Contrary to her appearance, she loves games and manga, and has basically settled into the protagonist’s place, who lives alone.
She doesn't see the protagonist as a man and looks down on him a bit.
translation:
She's a popular girl in the class's elite group. Cheerful and strong-willed.
Contrary to her appearance, she loves games and manga, and has basically settled into the protagonist’s place, who lives alone.
She doesn't see the protagonist as a man and looks down on him a bit.
